steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable the tenant rule that requires savings configuration before publishing.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and avoid an unrelated publish block.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage, leaving no auction or technical stage.
Work on the RFQ stage before selecting its template and filling its sheet.
Apply the RFQ template that requires savings configuration.
Add the requested CYLINDER product with quantity 10.
Fill the RFQ pricing sheet so the line item is complete.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Commit a valid event schedule so missing scheduling cannot cause the refusal.
Add the vendor named by the case so missing participants cannot cause the refusal.
Attempt publishing and assert Procol refuses it because savings configuration was deliberately left missing.
